title: Add end-to-end smoke test for dispatch/result-sync loop
description: Add an end-to-end smoke test or scripted demo that creates a temporary Beads workspace, creates a ready bead, builds a handoff packet, simulates dispatch, simulates result sync, and verifies the bead receives a comment/close operation. Must run locally without external services.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: A local smoke test validates the core durable-state-to-execution-loop without network or secrets.

title: Implement dry-run-first Kanban dispatch bridge
description: Implement the first bridge command that reads bd ready --json, builds handoff packets, and in dry-run mode prints the Hermes Kanban tasks it would create. Non-dry-run may remain guarded behind an explicit flag if Hermes Kanban invocation is not safe yet. This turns docs/kanban-bridge.md Phase 2 from design into code.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: A command exists that maps ready beads to kanban task payloads with no side effects by default; tests cover empty and non-empty ready queues.

title: Add GitHub Actions CI for privacy scan and pytest
description: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs on pull_request and push to main. It must run scripts/scan-privacy.sh, install the Python package, and run python -m pytest tests/ -v. This addresses reviewer concern: CONTRIBUTING mentions CI but no CI exists.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: PRs run privacy scan and pytest in GitHub Actions; README/CONTRIBUTING references are truthful.

title: Document cross-machine Beads sync protocol
description: Write docs/cross-machine-sync.md explaining how multiple Hermes agents/machines coordinate using bd dolt pull/push, refs/dolt/data, conflict expectations, and safe recovery. Include concrete session-start and session-end checklists. This addresses reviewer concern: cross-machine coordination is underspecified.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: Docs give a concrete, public-safe protocol for multiple agents sharing the same bead graph.

title: Populate handoff packet comments from Beads
description: Update src/hermes_beads/cli.py so handoff packets include Beads comments/decision notes when available. Investigate the current bd JSON shape and available comment commands; prefer bd-native JSON output, fall back to comments embedded in bd show --json if present. Add tests. This addresses reviewer concern: comments are specified in docs but currently always empty.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: hb handoff <id> --dry-run includes comments when bd exposes them; tests cover present and absent comments.

title: Document Beads usage inside this repository
description: Document how this repo uses bd as the durable task graph: run bd prime at session start, create or claim a bead before work, add public-safe comments for decisions and blockers, close beads after PR merge, and avoid treating issues.jsonl as source of truth.

title: Add changelog, SemVer, contribution guide, and PR template
description: Add CHANGELOG.md using Keep a Changelog style, document Semantic Versioning policy, create CONTRIBUTING.md, ROADMAP.md, docs/pr-flow.md, docs/build-in-public.md, and a GitHub pull request template. Every public change should be reviewable through PR flow.

title: Define Hermes-Beads metadata schema
description: Create docs/metadata-schema.md defining the public metadata contract for Hermes execution fields, lifecycle states, and handoff packet shape. Keep it narrow: durable operational state for disposable agents, not generic agent memory.

title: Add public repo guardrails
description: Create the initial public repository guardrails: README, LICENSE, .gitignore, SECURITY.md, docs/privacy.md, and privacy scan script. Keep all content public-safe: no local paths, IPs, tokens, private repo names, machine IDs, or copied private task data.

title: Specify gate resolver architecture
description: Write docs/gate-resolver.md specifying how Beads gates or metadata route work to the right Hermes profile, what signals are allowed, and how the resolver avoids embedding orchestration policy in Beads itself. This addresses reviewer concern: gate resolver is mentioned in roadmap but undesigned.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: A concrete gate resolver spec exists with scope boundaries, inputs, outputs, and anti-patterns.

title: Implement hermes_iteration retry tracking
description: Implement or document concrete behavior for metadata.hermes_iteration. The bridge should read the current iteration and increment it on failed/timeout retry, or the schema should be revised if iteration is out of scope. Add tests or docs accordingly. This addresses reviewer concern: iteration counter is specified but unused.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: hermes_iteration has implemented retry behavior or the schema explicitly scopes it out with rationale.

title: Tighten PR/release policy enforcement docs
description: Update CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/pr-flow.md to clarify: one bead per PR when practical, release bumps should go through PR unless explicitly designated as maintainer-only mechanical release commits, and task-graph-only changes may be committed directly only during orchestration. Address reviewer concern about direct release commits and bootstrap exceptions.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: Policy documents explain exceptions and make the one-bead/one-PR rule explicit.

title: Implement Kanban result sync back to Beads
description: Implement the result-sync side of the bridge: read completed/failed Hermes Kanban tasks, write result/failure summaries back to Beads as comments, close successful beads, and mark failed beads with retry metadata. This turns docs/kanban-bridge.md Phase 3 into code.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: A dry-run-first result sync command maps kanban results to bd comments/close operations and has tests.

title: Add minimal dry-run CLI skeleton
description: Add the first Python CLI skeleton for hermes-beads with dry-run-only commands such as --version, ready --dry-run, and handoff --dry-run. No live Hermes dispatch in this task. Add tests and CI once code exists.

title: Specify the Beads-generated handoff packet
description: Specify the handoff packet every Hermes worker should receive from a bead: goal, acceptance criteria, dependencies, decisions so far, known blockers, required checks, and stop condition. Include a public-safe example.

title: Add cron polling plan/script for bridge loop
description: Add a public-safe cron/polling integration for continuous bridge operation. It should describe or implement how Hermes cron runs dispatch and result-sync on a schedule without recursively scheduling jobs or leaking environment details.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: Bridge loop can be run periodically with a documented safe schedule and no secret leakage.

title: Specify dashboard for project state and agent health
description: Write docs/dashboard.md describing a future dashboard for Beads project state, Hermes worker health, bridge lag, failed tasks, and privacy-safe audit trail. Keep implementation out of scope unless the spec is trivial.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: Dashboard spec exists with metrics, views, data sources, and privacy boundaries.

title: Prototype gate-based profile selection
description: After docs/gate-resolver.md exists, add a small prototype that chooses hermes_profile from bead metadata/gate signals and feeds that into the dispatch payload. Keep it dry-run-first and covered by tests.

metadata.hermes_stop_condition: Dry-run dispatch shows profile selection derived from gate/metadata inputs; tests cover default and explicit profile cases.

title: Plan the Hermes Kanban dispatch bridge
description: Plan the later bridge that reads bd ready --json, creates Hermes Kanban tasks, writes kanban_task_id back to Beads, and syncs result/failure comments. This task is planning only; implementation waits until the metadata schema and handoff packet are merged.
